sources.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
sources.snippet: Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We ...

sources.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
sources.snippet: Chronos Policy learns robot policies on physical time: timestamped observations, time-aware attention, and actions queried at their future execution times.

sources.title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
sources.snippet: • We formulate robot policy learning in physical time by conditioning on observation capture times and queried action execution times. • We introduce Chronos Policy, a diffusion transformer with time-aware RoPE that learns directly from asynchronous, multi-rate observations, without aligning them to a fixed temporal grid.
